selections.rationale: Figure 2 is the only candidate that visibly shows the model-facing input route for OmniNA: example nucleotide sequences with tokenized segments and model responses. That directly matches the route evidence for mutation-effect scoring from wild-type/mutated nucleotide sequence into a tokenized nucleotide sequence and then into the model. The other candidates are either broader workflow diagrams or downstream evaluation/result plots rather than the concrete input interface.
